verdicts.reason: Both put the 'How It Works' CTA at the top above the headline, so the reading order is reversed. In both, the backdrop circle is pulled away from the suitcase and sits behind the logo as a stray blob. The legal text is shrunk past legibility and there are large dead gaps around the suitcase. B is a bit worse because its text column is jammed against the left edge (~17px margin vs ~30px in A), which makes it lopsided, while A's margins breathe slightly better even though its suitcase sits a little off-centre.
